description: This file defines build rules and installation procedures for various firmware packages, including AMD microcode, AMDGPU video driver firmware, and Radeon video driver firmware, used in the OpenWRT build system.

methods.name: Package/amd64-microcode/install
methods.description: Defines the installation steps for the AMD microcode package, copying microcode binary files into the appropriate firmware directory.

methods.name: Package/amdgpu-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines the installation steps for the AMDGPU driver firmware, copying firmware binary files into the appropriate directory.

methods.name: Package/radeon-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines the installation steps for Radeon driver firmware, copying firmware binary files into the appropriate directory.
